categories.main_business_segments: The company operates three primary business segments: (1) Network Game Business - developing and operating online games including client games, web games, and mobile games with a focus on red-themed games; (2) Cloud Service Business - providing IDC (Internet Data Center) services, data center operations, and related value-added services through subsidiary Baoteng互联; (3) Digital Twin and Cultural Tourism Business - leveraging digital twin technology to develop immersive experiences and cultural tourism projects including theme parks and interactive experience centers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes game development and operation technologies including client-server architecture, mobile game development frameworks, and cloud gaming technologies. For cloud services, it operates self-built data centers with Tier3+ standards and employs virtualization and cloud computing infrastructure. The digital twin business integrates mixed virtual reality, IoT, AI, and immersive experience technologies to create interactive digital experiences and cultural tourism products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include online game players across China and internationally, enterprise clients requiring IDC services (internet, finance, government sectors), and cultural tourism consumers. The company serves internet companies, financial institutions, government agencies, and tourism operators. End markets include the domestic gaming market, cloud computing/data center services market, and emerging digital cultural tourism sector.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with key presence in Shenzhen, Chengdu, and Leshan. It maintains data centers in Shenzhen (Guanlan), Chengdu, and Leshan. The company has subsidiaries in Hong Kong, the British Virgin Islands, and the United States (California), indicating international operations and overseas market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: in gaming, it functions as both developer/publisher and operator; in cloud services, it operates as a midstream/downstream service provider offering infrastructure and value-added services to enterprise customers; in digital tourism, it operates as an integrated operator combining technology development with direct consumer-facing experiences.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) developing premium game products with emphasis on red-themed/patriotic games and expanding overseas markets; (2) expanding cloud service capabilities including AI and machine learning applications, improving data center utilization rates, and developing cloud value-added services; (3) advancing digital twin technology applications across multiple sectors (digital brewing, digital weddings, digital tourism) and integrating digital technology with physical economy; (4) maintaining significant R&D investment despite current profitability challenges.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through: (1) Game Business - in-game purchases of virtual items and equipment using a freemium model with optional paid features; (2) Cloud Services - IDC machine cabinet rentals, bandwidth services, data center operations, and value-added services including maintenance and system sales; (3) Digital Twin and Cultural Tourism - theme park operations, immersive experience center admissions, and technology licensing/development services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In gaming, the company competes with major publishers and developers in China's competitive market. In cloud services, it competes with established IDC providers and major cloud service companies. The company positions itself as a mid-tier player focusing on niche markets (red-themed games, regional data centers) rather than competing directly with industry giants. It emphasizes specialized services and cultural differentiation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported 2023 revenue of 259.04 million yuan, down 5.72% from 274.76 million yuan in 2022. Net loss attributable to shareholders was 55.05 million yuan in 2023 versus 58.70 million yuan loss in 2022. Total assets were 897.55 million yuan at year-end 2023. The company is experiencing a contraction phase with declining revenues and continued losses, though showing slight improvement in net loss compared to prior year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) Red-themed/patriotic gaming content emphasizing Chinese culture and values, appealing to nationalist sentiment; (2) Integrated digital twin technology combining virtual reality, IoT, and AI for immersive cultural experiences; (3) Regional data center focus with emphasis on green, intelligent infrastructure aligned with China's digital economy initiatives; (4) Vertical integration combining technology development with direct consumer experiences in cultural tourism; (5) Focus on cultural IP development and heritage preservation through digital means.
